evidence: The Hump Ridge Great Walk begins at Rarakau car park.
The Hump Ridge Track starts from the Rarakau car park near Tuatapere in southern Fiordland.
Continue north on the South Coast Track. The track leads around the edge of Te Waewae Bay and back to Rarakau car park.

doubts: The loop is a lollipop: days 1 and 3 both follow the South Coast Track along Te Waewae Bay between Rarakau car park and the Hump Ridge Track junction / Port Craig; the text does not name a direction (clockwise/anticlockwise). Rarakau car park taken as F1 (where South Coast Track meets Papatotara Coast Road), the only road end in the packet. Percy Burn viaduct given as F2 (the feature named for the viaduct); Edwin Burn given as the river T3 crossed by its viaduct. Ōkaka Lodge and Port Craig Lodge have no lodge entries (T13 Ōkākā is a ridge, T9 Port Craig a place), so their refs are null except where the Port Craig settlement side trip is meant.
